references.text: The same prohibition against ruling harshly over an Israelite servant, emphasizing the principle of humane treatment of fellow Israelites
Contrasts the treatment of Israelite servants with foreign slaves and reiterates the prohibition against ruling harshly over brothers
The Egyptians forced the Israelites into hard labor (פֶּרֶךְ); the same word is used here as a reminder of their own experience of oppression
Laws concerning Hebrew servants and their rights, including limited-term service
Parallel legislation regarding the treatment of Hebrew servants as hired workers
Command to treat hired workers fairly and to pay wages daily
Reference to human life as the service of a hired worker, with the same concept of annual service
Paul exhorts masters to treat their servants fairly and without threats, in accordance with the principle of humane treatment
Masters are exhorted to give their servants what is right and fair, in line with the Old Testament principle
